examples.name: Moticont LVCM-070-051-01
examples.continuous_force_reference_position: center peak of published continuous-force vs stroke plot
examples.stated_conditions: All values at 25°C; installed thermal boundary and hot ratings not established by retrieved sheet.
examples.status: Closer moving-mass reference; 0.24 kg fits within 0.6 kg provision leaving 0.36 kg; continuous 60 N over full stroke not proven, A must increase, drive/thermal qualification required.

examples.name: Sensata LAS28-53-000A-P01
examples.status: Fails B=0.6 kg moving assembly provision; efficiency reference only. Integrated position specification does not qualify 1 um sensing.

moving_magnet_negative_reference.name: H2W NCM10-14-028-2BX
moving_magnet_negative_reference.status: Light and correct stroke but force/efficiency targets fail; does not establish absence of any custom moving-magnet solution.

inference_contract.motor_constant: Kf/sqrt(R) calculated from nominal values; not continuous force guarantee.
inference_contract.copper_heating: (F/Kf)^2*R at stated center/cold reference; hot R/Kf, cooling and duty must be included.
inference_contract.rail_headroom: Vbus - I*R; excludes back EMF, Ldi/dt, amplifier losses and hot resistance.
inference_contract.continuous_force_curve: Report labeled continuous force plot only. No exact Kf(x), temperature map or endpoint duration inferred.
inference_contract.current_response: L/R is winding passive time constant, not controlled current loop response; peak force does not prove 100 us response.
inference_contract.mass_partition: Motor moving mass is part of B; stationary body + mount is part of A/robot payload; do not silently leave A=0.4 kg.

next_native_checks: Integrator-owned real winding simulation with Kf24.4, R6.4, L4mH, A including 1.24kg stationary body + mount, B0.6, S2; 24/36/48V cold/hot.
Separate matched winding/controller identification from unknown Kf/R/L/response mismatch.
Inspect actual voltage/current clipping and waveform changes; higher V does not solve continuous I²R heating.
Characterize usable-stroke force/current/temperature relation, cooling, cable force, guides and sensor assembly mass before prototype qualification.
recommendation: Use approximate envelope in prototype recommendation, with Moticont 240g moving coil as real reference; do not claim a fully qualified catalog motor or exact full-stroke 60N capability.
